intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kissimmee for 2026, and here is what he found: 19 family events, 12 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (ICE featuring The Polar Express at Christmas at Gaylord Palms) through January 6 (Festival of Lights and Snow at Kissimmee Lakefront Park), with the Kissimmee Tree Lighting Ceremony (November 28), An Osceola Christmas (December 5) and the Festival of Lights Parade and Holiday Festival (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kissimmee

  • 19 Christmas events for kids in Kissimmee
  • 12 free events, including the Tree Lighting Ceremony, An Osceola Christmas, Holiday Nights Celebration, Breakfast with Santa in Pajamas and Santa's Toy Drive
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa in Pajamas (December 19), Santa's Toy Drive (December 13) and An Osceola Christmas
  • Parades and tree lightings: Kissimmee Tree Lighting Ceremony (November 28) and the Festival of Lights Parade (December 12)
  • Trains: ICE featuring The Polar Express at Christmas at Gaylord Palms and the Holiday Nights train at the Promenade at Sunset Walk
  • Season: November 13 to January 6

Planning a bigger day out? Kissimmee families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Orlando, which covers Holidays at Walt Disney World Resort, Holidays at Universal Orlando Resort, SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration and Dazzling Nights at Harry P. Leu Gardens.
